claims.quote: This species is currently accepted to be the most common member of the genus with a wide distribution extending southwards from the Mekong river drainage in Laos, Vietnam, and Thailand to the Greater Sunda Islands of Sumatra, Borneo, and Java, via the Chao Phraya and Mae Klong river systems in central and western Thailand and numerous fluvial systems in Peninsular Malaysia.
